integrity: Exact theorem from local degree obstruction and inclusion-exclusion; classical coupon-collector limit is a consequence, not claimed new. Exhaustive finite program checks eight small parameter cases, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Surplus palettes Q>=r+2 only, fixed clique petal size r>=2, m>=1. Limit uses fixed r and rm/(Q-1)-log(Q-1) converging to a real constant. Does not extend to arbitrary block graphs. Priority not independently established.
title: A palette-driven two-step forcing threshold for clique windmills
